name: paragraph-lock
description: Approval-gated paragraph editing that preserves every unapproved part of the baseline.

interface.shortDescription: Revise approved text without collateral rewrites.
interface.longDescription: Discuss one bounded passage at a time, approve exact wording, and assemble the full text from a frozen baseline plus approved replacements only.
defaultPrompt: Use ParagraphLock to revise one paragraph without changing anything else.
Use ParagraphLock and show the full text only after verification.
